summary: The benchmark run reports common annual 2022-to-2024 and November-2022-to-June-2026 endpoints for all employed and feasible full-time civilian wage-and-salary CPS populations. Unavailable positive-payroll-match and firm-control conditions remain distinct. No-Webb public-benchmark rows are separated from the labeled Webb-controlled YAX extension, and paired sample-alignment differences preserve common-draw covariance.
